I haven't finished t13-reuse-billing-cycle. Team memory has no record of the Bolt Billing API billing cycle from sprint S07, and I won't make one up.

- **Billing cycle:** Five recalls (queries on "billing", "Bolt", "Bolt Billing API S07" and similar) returned nothing about a billing cycle or Bolt Billing. The S07 facts that do exist cover only the API version (v14), the database, the purpose and auth.
